input.changeSummary: Start, end, IdP and membership decisions

steps.title: An unauthenticated public official opens a Portal Funcionario route
steps.detail: An unauthenticated public official opens any Portal Funcionario route.

steps.title: Opens the portal without a session and selects Sign In
Authenticates with Llave Morelos at the identity provider, outside the portal
steps.detail: Returns to the portal with a valid session; memberships are counted

steps.title: Does the IdP authenticate?
steps.detail: 2b · If the IdP does not authenticate, the account is blocked, or the organization is outside the Hub gate, returns to Access.

steps.title: Access not granted
steps.detail: 2b · IdP authentication fails, the account is blocked, or the organization is outside the Hub gate: returns to Access with “Access not granted” and Retry.

steps.title: How many memberships are there?
steps.detail: None: account pending activation (403). One: directly opens that organization's Home. Several: opens portal Home (step 3b).

steps.title: Account pending activation (403)
steps.detail: 3a · Valid session with no memberships: sees Account pending activation (403), root shell without menu or actions: a dead end.

steps.title: With several memberships, opens portal Home and reviews Your turn, Inbox, or My organizations
steps.detail: Sees organizations with the role held in each (step 3b)

steps.title: Selects Enter on an organization
steps.detail: Lands on organization Home; rail switches to the Department group and footer shows the organization role

steps.title: Opens My spaces and chooses Citizen services or Procedures and services
Works in the space's Home
steps.detail: Rail uses the space menu, topbar adds the space selector; footer role comes from that membership

steps.title: Switches organization using rail ⇕, ⌘O, or user menu, choosing another while seeing the prospective role
steps.detail: Token is reissued and the selected organization opens

steps.title: Works in a space of the selected organization
steps.detail: The public official works in a space's Home in the selected organization, with that membership's role, and can switch organization from the shell.

input.note: Llave Morelos has no integration node: the step was reviewed from its description only.

input.notes: Llave Morelos integration is missing (owner decision pending).
